categories.label: Filing Formalities
categories.prompt: Assess Form 28 for this SLP (Civil): court and jurisdiction caption, party positions, the petition body, mandatory declarations, grounds, prayers, and any supporting affidavit this task names. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score other Form 28 points, other categories, or legal merit.

categories.label: Advocate's Check List
categories.prompt: Assess the Advocate's Check List and the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on this filing, including the signature block. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Listing Proforma
categories.prompt: Assess the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) that accompanies the filing. Decide only whether the columns or particulars named in this task are duly filled. Do not score other listing fields unless this task names them.

categories.label: Petition Presentation
categories.prompt: Assess the form of the petition: consecutive paragraph and page numbering, and how the petition is produced. Decide only the objection in the user message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

defects.defect: AoR has not filed the requisite checklist in the prescribed format along with the Petition/Appeal.
defects.requirement: AoR must file a checklist along with every Petition. The checklist must in be in accordance with the prescribed format.
where_to_look: Check the front of the case file, before the Cover Page and the Office Report on Limitation, for the Advocate's Checklist.
Check whether it is in the prescribed format, i.e. the numbered list of requirements each marked YES/NO/N.A., followed by the AOR's declaration.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the Advocate's Check List in the prescribed format.
Option for the User to upload the Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition along with the Advocate's Check List.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D003. D003 is whether the Advocate's Check List was filed in the prescribed format. This check is only whether the Advocate-on-Record's code number appears in the certificate (checklist signature block and the certificate after Main Prayer), with a cross-check against the Vakalatnama. Do not re-decide whether the checklist exists.
defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record's code number is not mentioned in the certificate.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record's code number must be mentioned in the certificate.
where_to_look: Check the Advocate's Check List at the front of the case file, in the signature block below the declaration.
Check for the Advocate-on-Record's code number stated alongside the Advocate-on-Record's name. Cross-check the same code against the Vakalatnama at the end of the file.
Also check the certificate found after the Main Prayer clause.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to provide the Advocate-on-Record's code number and auto-fill it in the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on the Advocate's Check List.
Option for the User to edit the Advocate-on-Record's code number in the certificate with Jubeex.
Re-upload the duly certified Advocate's Check List.
defects.location_source: Page 6, SCI_CHECKLIST_2025. End of Checklist contains signature block with Date, Signature of AOR, Name & Code of AOR

defects.defect: The petition does not consist of paragraphs and pages numbered consecutively, or is not fairly and legibly typed, lithographed or printed on both sides of standard A4 size paper with a quarter margin.
defects.requirement: Every petition must consist of paragraphs and pages numbered consecutively and shall be fairly and legibly type-written, lithographed or printed on both sides of standard A4 size paper with a quarter margin.
where_to_look: Verify that paragraphs and pages are numbered consecutively.
Check that the petition is fairly and legibly typed, lithographed or printed on both sides of standard A4 paper with the required quarter margin.
how_to_cure: Consecutive numbering of paragraphs — Option for Jubeex to auto-number the paragraphs consecutively.
Consecutive numbering of paragraphs — Option for the User to edit the paragraph numbering with Jubeex.
Consecutive numbering of paragraphs — Re-upload the petition.
Consecutive numbering of pages — Option for Jubeex to auto-number the pages consecutively.
Consecutive numbering of pages — Option for the User to edit the page numbering with Jubeex.
Consecutive numbering of pages — Re-upload the petition.
Legible scans — Option for Jubeex to OCR and create legible, clear versions of the petition.
defects.location_source: SCI_RULES_2013, Page 19 of the PDF Supreme Court Rules, 2013

defects.defect: Columns Nos.6 and 7 of Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing not duly filled in
defects.requirement: Columns Nos.6 and 7 of Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing must be duly filled in
where_to_look: Check the Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing and check Columns 6 and 7 of the Proforma for First Listing are duly filled. Flag if these details are stated/filed
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to enter the information required for Columns 6 and 7 of the Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing, and option for Jubeex to fill the relevant columns using the information provided.
Option for the User to re-upload the Listing Proforma.
